anotherco-anotherco:lever:ae51bfed-7869-.description: OUR JOB IS TO REVOLUTIONIZE THE STRATEGIC COMMUNICATION We are another.co, a global communications agency founded in 2004. we have been transforming the way things are done. Revolution is in our DNA, and it guides every project we undertake. Our mission is clear: to create inspirational, powerful, and creative storytelling that is always culturally relevant, leveraging the integration of our expert teams who can work across any channel, anywhere. Our vision is ambitious: we believe the right stories have the power to change everything. Every campaign, piece of content, and idea that comes from another aims to make a real impact. If you want to join a place where creativity has no limits and impact is real, this is your space. Why Join Us? This is your chance to be part of the another Community, an innovative and multicultural team that’s redefining the rules of communication. If you're passionate about strategy, creativity, and results, this is the place for you. WE ARE HIRING: Contador General Requisitos Licenciatura en Contaduría Pública, Contabilidad o carrera afín. Más de 5 años de experiencia en posiciones contables. Experiencia en contabilidad general y elaboración de estados financieros. Experiencia en cierres contables mensuales y anuales. Conocimiento sólido en cálculo y presentación de impuestos. Conocimiento actualizado de obligaciones fiscales ante el SAT. Manejo de ISR, IVA, DIOT y conciliaciones contables y fiscales. Experiencia en atención y seguimiento de auditorías internas y externas. Manejo avanzado de Excel. Experiencia con sistemas contables y/o ERP. Actividades Ejecutar y supervisar los procesos de contabilidad general de la compañía. Realizar cierres contables mensuales y anuales, asegurando la correcta integración de la información. Elaborar y analizar estados financieros y reportes contables. Realizar conciliaciones bancarias y depuración de cuentas contables. Calcular, revisar y presentar impuestos y obligaciones fiscales en tiempo y forma. Dar seguimiento a requerimientos y trámites ante autoridades fiscales. Asegurar el correcto registro de ingresos, egresos, provisiones y demás operaciones contables. Preparar información y documentación para auditorías internas y externas. Analizar variaciones e identificar posibles inconsistencias en la información financiera. Mantener actualizados los registros y soportes contables. Apoyar en la generación de reportes financieros para la toma de decisiones. Garantizar el cumplimiento de políticas internas y normatividad contable y fiscal aplicable. Habilidades Capacidad analítica. Organización y atención al detalle. Proactividad. Trabajo en equipo. Comunicación efectiva. Orientación a resultados. Resolución de problemas. Manejo de información confidencial. Capacidad para trabajar bajo presión y cumplir fechas límite. Alto sentido de responsabilidad.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:a8018d26-74d6-.title: Business Developer - Trade Finance
jobgether-jobgether:lever:a8018d26-74d6-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Business Developer – Trade Finance based in Netherlands. As a Business Developer, you will drive the origination and development of strategic relationships with Trade Finance Institutions. You will identify and prioritize prospective partners while uncovering opportunities that support broader commercial objectives. The role combines financial expertise, relationship management, business development, and technology-enabled market intelligence. You will engage directly with banks, fintechs, clearing institutions, brokerages, and other financial organizations. Modern software and AI-supported techniques will help you research markets, assess prospects, and work efficiently with complex information. You will operate with significant autonomy in a global commodities environment while collaborating closely with commercial teams. The position offers strong performance-based incentives and the opportunity to build a valuable track record in international trade finance. Originate and develop relationships with Trade Finance Institutions in support of strategic business objectives. Identify, assess, and prioritize prospective Trade Finance Institutions using public and proprietary data sources and modern software-based research techniques. Build and maintain relationships with Trade Finance Banks, fintechs, clearing banks, derivatives brokerages, and other relevant financial institutions. Interface directly with representatives of prospective and existing institutions to identify opportunities for collaboration. Work closely with commercial teams to understand business needs and translate them into actionable business development opportunities. Leverage existing institutional relationships and networks to accelerate prospecting and partnership development. Research financial institutions, markets, and counterparties to identify relevant opportunities and assess their strategic potential. Apply data-driven and AI-enabled approaches, including emerging automation and retrieval-based technologies, to improve prospect identification and business development efficiency. Communicate complex financial and commercial concepts clearly and effectively to internal and external stakeholders. Represent the organization professionally in meetings, industry interactions, and relevant business development activities. Build a strong personal track record of successful relationships, transactions, and business development outcomes. Requirements: Demonstrated proficiency in the functions and operation of various trade finance instruments and trade finance credit facilities. Strong understanding of financial statements, including the ability to analyze and interpret relevant financial indicators, KPIs, and ratios. Proven professional experience interfacing directly with Trade Finance Banks or comparable financial institutions. Strong business development and relationship-building capabilities, with the ability to identify opportunities and develop them into meaningful commercial relationships. Genuine curiosity about business process automation and emerging technologies, including the practical use of AI agents and software-enabled research tools. Ability to analyze complex information, identify relevant insights, and prioritize opportunities effectively. Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to communicate complex ideas precisely, concisely, and persuasively. Ability to work independently in a remote, international environment while collaborating effectively with commercial and financial stakeholders. Valid authorization to work in the location of employment; work permit sponsorship is not available. Candidates should ideally be habitually resident within commuting distance of a major trade finance center such as Zurich/Geneva, Frankfurt, Paris, London, Dubai, Singapore, Hong Kong, Shangha

southparkcommons-pulley:ashbyhq:80238edc.title: Strategic Account Lead
southparkcommons-pulley:ashbyhq:80238edc.description: About Pulley Pulley helps the country’s top architects, builders, and retailers speed up every project in their portfolio. With AI-powered permitting intelligence and expert guidance, we eliminate costly delays and bring predictability across the full lifecycle of commercial projects. Today, permitting is the slowest, most uncertain part of building, spread across 19,000+ jurisdictions with different rules, timelines, and surprises. Pulley gives project teams the clarity and predictability they need to move from planning to opening without delays. We support rollout programs for brands like J.Crew, Solidcore, and Hibbett Sports, as well as major data center buildouts, EV charging networks, and other commercial projects. Our platform dramatically reduces approval timelines, improves forecasting accuracy, and removes thousands of hours of manual work from design and construction teams. Founded in 2021, Pulley combines deep permitting expertise with purpose-built AI from people who have created products used by millions. We’re backed by CRV, Susa Ventures, Fifth Wall, and leaders from Plaid, Segment, ServiceTitan, and Procore. ABOUT THE ROLE As a Strategic Account Lead, you'll own 1–2 of Pulley's largest enterprise accounts — you're the main point of contact for the customer and the link between what they need and what our internal teams deliver. You keep the customer confident and informed, keep our team stocked with the context it needs, and step in early when something needs attention. This role fits someone genuinely customer-obsessed: you treat the customer's goals as your own, stay a step ahead of what they'll ask for, and measure your success by theirs. This role is remote and designed for someone who wants to be embedded near the customer they support. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Portfolio Visibility & Program Coordination: Keep a current view of your account's full project portfolio — not to manage individual projects, but to represent the program confidently, catch patterns early, and keep everyone aligned. Meet regularly with Regional Leads to check on project health, flag anything that could affect delivery, and make sure internal teams have the context they need. - Customer Relationship Management: Be the go-to contact for decision-makers throughout the account. Build trust through consistent, proactive communication. Lead regular check-ins and monthly account reviews, and partner with the Account Executive on QBRs and renewals. When needed, represent the customer in city and AHJ meetings alongside our Permit Ops team. - Stakeholder Onboarding & Program Growth: As the account grows, onboard new stakeholders on both sides — training new members of the customer's team and bringing in outside collaborators like architects and engineers of record. - Internal Resource & Cross-Functional Enablement: Act as the internal voice of the customer. Turn what you're hearing from the account into clear, useful input for Regional Leads, Head of Permitting, Operations, Product, or Sales. Help unblock issues only the customer relationship can solve, and push for process improvements that make the program work better for everyone. WHO YOU ARE Required - 4–8 years of experience in project management, program management, or a related client-facing role - Background in construction, real estate, architecture, permitting, or a related field — enough fluency to read project status, understand permitting terminology, spot risks early, and communicate credibly - Genuinely customer-obsessed — you treat the customer's goals as your own, you're proactive before they have to ask, and you're energized by being the person they most trust and rely on - Demonstrated ability to go deep on a large, complex project or program — comfortable overseeing concurrent workstreams and knowing exactly when to zoom in - Strong communicator — you write clearly, respond quickly, and know how to translate complex updates into crisp, customer-facing language that builds confide
